title: Does It Still Match?

narrative.intro: Compliance wants a quick answer before the quarterly review: does what's actually running in prod match BL-01, the last configuration anyone formally signed off on? You pull up both refs to check. Nothing about this smells like an incident - no unsigned commits, no missing CR reference, nothing that looks like it slipped past review.
narrative.correctDebrief: Correct - prod is one commit past BL-01, and that commit was never itself audited or folded into a new baseline. Nothing about it looks suspicious: it's signed, the fix is reasonable, nobody did anything wrong. That's exactly the point - Configuration Audit isn't about catching bad actors, it's about catching this: a perfectly fine change that shipped without anyone re-running the approval loop, so the official record ("BL-01 is what's approved") quietly stopped being true the moment it landed.
narrative.incorrectDebrief: Compare the two refs directly instead of scanning for anything that looks wrong. Is prod's commit the exact same commit BL-01 points to, or does prod sit one step further down the graph, on a commit BL-01 never covered?
